name: focustimer
description: A Focus Timer built with React and Neutralinojs
author: Antigravity

scripts.build:widget: powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Force -Recurse public\downloads, dist, neu_dist -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue ; npm run build ; npx @neutralinojs/neu build --release ; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path public\downloads -Force ; C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe /target:winexe /r:System.Windows.Forms.dll /resource:neu_dist\FocusTimer_Widget\FocusTimer_Widget-win_x64.exe,FocusTimer_Widget_core.exe /resource:neu_dist\FocusTimer_Widget\resources.neu,resources.neu /out:public\downloads\FocusTimer_Widget.exe Launcher.cs"
